mapper.select: SELECT user_id AS userId, email, password, name, phone, birth_date AS birthDate, role, status, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt, last_login_at AS lastLoginAt FROM users WHERE email = #{email}

SELECT user_id AS userId, email, password, name, phone, birth_date AS birthDate, role, status, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt, last_login_at AS lastLoginAt FROM users WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users ( email, password, name, phone, birth_date, role, status, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{email}, #{password}, #{name}, #{phone}, #{birthDate}, #{role}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET last_login_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE users password = #{password}, name = #{name}, phone = #{phone}, birth_date = #{birthDate}, role = #{role}, status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.delete: UPDATE users SET email = 'withdrawn_' || user_id || '_' || email, password = '', role = 'WITHDRAWN', status = 'WITHDRAWN', updated_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId}
